description: Na₃MgMo(OF)₃ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to three O and two F atoms to form distorted NaO₃F₂ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₂F₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.39 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.79 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.62 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to two O and two F atoms to form NaO₂F₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₃F₂ square pyramids and corners with three equivalent MgO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond length. There is one shorter (2.32 Å) and one longer (2.33 Å) Na-F bond length. Mg is bonded to two O and three F atoms to form distorted MgO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₃F₂ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent NaO₂F₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₃F₂ square pyramid. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Mg-O bond length. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.11 Å. Mo is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.93 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.55 Å) Mo-F bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent FNa₃Mg tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent FNa₂MgMo trigonal pyramids. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mg atom to form distorted FNa₃Mg tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids and corners with three equivalent FNa₂MgMo trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted FNa₂MgMo trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent FNa₃Mg tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids.
